name: 44224 · Stow, OH
findings: ZIP 44224 (Stow) has 127 nonprofit organizations. 48 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44224 (Stow) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 44224 (Stow) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 13 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
